paragraph: In May 2023 the ministry's director of telecommunications said [Angola's terrestrial fibre exceeds 22,000 km and connects all provincial and communal capitals](<https://minttics.gov.ao/ao/noticias/matias-borges-dois-novos-projectos-vao-garantir-a-expansao-dos-servicos-de-comunicacoes-nos-municipios-e-nas-comunas/>). In the last twelve months, the first link of a new national broadband backbone, from Luanda to Benguela, [opened at Lobito in September 2026](<https://www.angop.ao/noticias/tecnologia/rede-de-banda-larga-de-fibra-optica-ja-funciona-em-benguela/>). It is meant to reach all 21 provinces. In November 2026 the minister said the national broadband network is [still being extended across the country](<https://pti.ao/angola-apresenta-a-uit-projectos-de-fibra-optica-satelite-e-cloud/>). No source found says other operators buy capacity on the backbone, or that it runs on open-access or wholesale terms. Mature would need other operators to buy capacity on it, or it to run on open-access or wholesale terms.

[ARCT states BBS's fibre (1,750 km) covers all provinces of Burundi and that the national territory is now covered by fibre optic, as at 31 December 2024](<https://arct.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/RAPPORT-DES-INDICATEURS-DU-SECTEUR-DES-TIC-EDITION-2024-VALIDE-ET-PUBLIE-1.pdf>). BBS is the Burundi Backbone System, listed in the regulator's 2024 indicators report as a fibre infrastructure operator. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says other operators buy capacity on this fibre, or that it runs on open-access or wholesale terms. Mature would need other operators to buy capacity on it, or it to run on open-access or wholesale terms.

Benin Telecom signed a contract with Huawei in 2014 for [rehabilitating a 1,060 km fibre backbone from Cotonou to Malanville](<https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/ce/cebenin/chn/zbgx/t1239853.htm>). [Implementation began in December 2016](<https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/ce/cebenin/chn/zbgx/t1239853.htm>), and the deal record gives the project as [completed, with 2018 as its end year](<https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/ce/cebenin/chn/zbgx/t1239853.htm>). No change has been found in the last twelve months, and nothing found dates new backbone works since 2018. No source found says the backbone reaches every department, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[SMART Burkina, about 800 km of fibre linking 22 cities, was completed in August 2025](<https://www.bu.edu/gdp/files/2022/11/GCI_PB_012_EN_FIN.pdf>). [Its operator says the network has run commercially since March 2023 and covers almost the whole territory](<https://digitalmagazine.bf/2026/08/18/interview-avec-sagadibwaoga-michel-ouedraogo-dg-de-bfs-le-backbone-national-a-tenu-ses-promesses-trois-ans-dexploitation-de-la-fibre-optique-publique-burkinabe/>). In the last twelve months, [Bridge Fiber Solutions, which runs the state backbone, sold capacity on it to 44 customers in August 2026](<https://digitalmagazine.bf/2026/08/18/interview-avec-sagadibwaoga-michel-ouedraogo-dg-de-bfs-le-backbone-national-a-tenu-ses-promesses-trois-ans-dexploitation-de-la-fibre-optique-publique-burkinabe/>). It had 7 in 2023. They include all three mobile operators, internet providers, state firms and banks. Its prices follow a catalogue that ARCEP and the ministry validate each year.

[In May 2025 BoFiNet's acting chief executive said it had laid about 12,400 km of fibre](<https://www.bwtechzone.com/2025/05/how-bofinet-plans-to-transform-botswana.html>). In the last twelve months, [the communications minister said in March 2026 that about 16,000 km of fibre is laid across Botswana](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/90463>). It links the country to South Africa, Namibia, Zimbabwe and Zambia. [BoFiNet reported 99.7% availability across its backbone at its August 2026 annual meeting](<https://na.co.bw/bofinet-hosts-agm-showcasing-enhanced-accountability-and-value-creation/>). No source found says the backbone reaches every district. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[AfDB says that at project close in September 2023 the first national optical backbone was installed](<https://www.afdb.org/fr/news-and-events/les-jeunes-centrafricains-formes-aux-metiers-du-numerique-grace-la-fibre-optique-installee-avec-lappui-de-la-banque-africaine-de-developpement-et-de-lunion-europeenne-69893>). [It had 900 km of fibre, eleven technical sites, a network operations centre in Bangui and two community digital centres](<https://www.afdb.org/fr/news-and-events/les-jeunes-centrafricains-formes-aux-metiers-du-numerique-grace-la-fibre-optique-installee-avec-lappui-de-la-banque-africaine-de-developpement-et-de-lunion-europeenne-69893>), and links the country to Cameroon and Congo. [The Minister and Africa24 state 1,200 km of fibre optic is in place in CAR](<https://africa24tv.com/republique-centrafricaine-le-taux-de-penetration-dinternet-atteint-30/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states it does.

[In June 2026 ANSUT's infrastructure director said its national broadband network has more than 6,600 km of fibre](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2642807/societe/forum-intech-sante-2026-lansut-presente-sa-feuille-de-route-pour-connecter-les-zones-rurales-et-moderniser-lacces-aux-soins>). ANSUT is the universal service agency. In the last twelve months the length laid rose from the 5,207 km of a planned 6,632 km that [ANSUT reported in April 2025](<https://fr.linkedin.com/pulse/le-r%C3%A9seau-national-haut-d%C3%A9bit-rnhd-un-pilier-essentiel-pour-la-transformation-tiuce>). [In April 2025 it said the network carries traffic for Orange CI, MTN CI and Moov Africa CI, and for internet providers](<https://fr.linkedin.com/pulse/le-r%C3%A9seau-national-haut-d%C3%A9bit-rnhd-un-pilier-essentiel-pour-la-transformation-tiuce>). No source found says the backbone reaches every region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[The telecoms regulator ART reported that in 2024 Camtel's national fibre backbone served all ten regional capitals](<https://ecomatin.net/cameroun-camtel-a-gagne-34-milliards-fcfa-grace-a-la-fibre-optique-en-2024-en-hausse-de-17>). It also reached 51 of 58 divisional capitals. [Camtel makes dark fibre available to MTN Cameroon under a contract](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/cameroun-ralph-mupita-pdg-de-mtn-group-va-investir-100-millions-en-2025-et-300-millions-sur-03-ans/>), Digital Business Africa reported in December 2024. In the last twelve months, [NewsWatch put Camtel's backbone at over 15,000 km in July 2026](<https://newswatchcameroon.com/cameroon-starlink-licensing-stalls-over-security-sovereignty-concerns/>), against nearly 12,000 km in ART's 2024 figures. In November 2026 ART said its audit of [the 112 sections of Camtel's network found serious degradation](<https://art.cm/sites/default/files/documents/COMMUNIQUE%20ART%2010%20NOV%202026.pdf>), with repeated cuts and some sections out of service.

[The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications told the Council of Ministers that 7,000 km of fibre is currently deployed](<https://deskeco.com/2026/08/03/transformation-numerique-en-rdc-encore-11500-km-de-fibre-optique-deployer-pour-atteindre-un-total-de>). It adds 11,500 km more under the Digital Transformation Project. [Minister Augustin Kibassa Maliba said about 12,000 km of a planned 55,000 km national fibre backbone was completed](<https://reg-tech.co/2025/05/06/drc-e-government-initiative-blockchain>); it mainly links major urban hubs. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says it reaches every province. Operating would need a source stating the backbone reaches every province.

[In August 2024 the French Treasury said the national coverage project had laid about 3,000 km of fibre](<https://www.tresor.economie.gouv.fr/Pays/CG/le-secteur-du-numerique>). It links Pointe-Noire, Dolisie, Brazzaville, Oyo and Ouesso, and Congo Telecom operates it. In the last twelve months, [Xalam Analytics described the project as still under way in January 2026](<https://cms.d4dhub.eu/assets/Initiatives/Data-Governance-in-Africa/Digital-Investment-Facility/Data-Center-Market-Briefs-Congo-Republic-2026.pdf>), at about 3,000 km connecting key towns. No source found says the backbone reaches every department, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[The Ministry of Communication (MCPT) says DFN has deployed over 200 km of fibre in Djibouti-ville and the interior regions](<https://www.lanation.dj/ali-sabieh-le-dfn-propulse-lhopital-regional-dans-une-nouvelle-ere-numerique/>). The fibre connects hospitals, schools and public bodies. [MCPT says the World Bank-financed DFN and EARDIP projects are deploying fibre optic networks in Djibouti-ville, Balbala and the five interior regions](<https://www.lanation.dj/transition-numerique-les-parties-prenantes-mobilisees-autour-des-projets-dfn-et-eardip/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states that it does.

In the last twelve months, Algérie Télécom's chief executive said in 2026 that [the group had finished nearly 300,000 km of backbone fibre](<https://alger16.dz/?p=60388>). It covers every wilaya. Earlier, [Algérie360 had reported in April 2025 a network of 260,000 km](<https://www.algerie360.com/zerrouki-devoile-la-feuille-de-route-de-la-5g-et-les-avancees-du-service-universel/>). It covered 95 per cent of the territory. In November 2024 the company told an ITU meeting that [more than 40,000 km of its fibre was available to other operators](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-D/Regional-Presence/ArabStates/Documents/events/2024/MeaningfulConnectivity/Presentations/Session3/Pr%C3%A9sentation%20Interconnexion%20UIT_MrAmirKahli.pdf>). [In October 2026 L'Echo d'Algérie reported the same length of cable laid across all wilayas](<https://lechodalgerie.dz/fibre-optique-en-lalgerie-4-millions-de-foyers-raccordes/>).

No stage is set. [Telecom Egypt says it sells transmission and wholesale services to all the other operators](<https://ir.te.eg/en/CorporateNews/PressRelease/209/Telecom-Egypt-and-Vodafone-Egypt-Strengthen-Strategic-Partnership-with-New-Service-Agreements>). [In February 2025 it extended its transmission agreement with Orange Egypt to 2032](<https://ir.te.eg/en/CorporateNews/PressRelease/216/Telecom-Egypt-and-Orange-Egypt-Sign-Agreements-to-Provide-Transmission-and-Infrastructure-Services>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says where its backbone runs, or that it links Cairo to other regions. Establishing would need backbone fibre in service between the capital and at least one other region, whoever owns it.

[Ethio telecom says that in its reporting period it deployed 793 km of new backbone fibre, bringing its national backbone network to 23,442.1 km (regions served not listed)](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/08/20/ethio-telecom-active-deployment-africa-middle-east-fibre-corridor/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[In October 2026 the head of SPIN, the state infrastructure holding, said its backbone runs about 2,000 km](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-numerique-interview-bertrand-mahoukou-bitchinda-expose-la-strategie-de-la-spin-pour-etendre-la-fibre-optique/>). It follows the railway from Libreville to Franceville and reaches Makokou and Cameroon. Two of the nine provinces are not yet connected. In the last twelve months, [on 14 September 2026 SPIN signed a 20-year partnership with Gabon Fiber](<https://spin.ga/backbone-national-gabonais-spin-gabon-fiber/>), which takes over the existing 1,782 km. [A 196 km section to Mouila was commissioned on 6 October 2026](<https://spin.ga/backbone-national-gabonais-196-km-de-fibre-optique/>). Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[WeAreTech Africa reports the minister's 2025 sector review as saying nearly 12,000 km of fibre optic was deployed to connect all administrative regions](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/guinea-reviews-2025-digital-sector-gains-targets-faster-rollout-in-2026>). In the last twelve months, [on 20 May 2026 SOGEB, the national backbone operator, announced an upgrade to the first loop of the national fibre-optic backbone](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2205-138703-la-guinee-augmente-la-capacite-de-son-reseau-internet-de-700-en-un-an-et-demi>). It raised the loop from 200 to 400 Gb/s. It had raised it from 50 to 200 Gb/s in December 2024. No source found says other operators buy capacity on it. Mature would need them to buy capacity, or open-access terms.

[WBBA states GAMTEL's National Broadband Network was deployed in 2019, with 420 km of fibre-optic links and around 31 central office sites](<https://worldbroadbandassociation.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/WBBA-GAMTEL_Final.pdf>). [It extends the 2015 ECOWAN backbone and 947 km of legacy fibre in four rings](<https://worldbroadbandassociation.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/WBBA-GAMTEL_Final.pdf>). [WBBA calls it a national backbone serving all key areas of the country](<https://worldbroadbandassociation.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/WBBA-GAMTEL_Final.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[Agence Ecofin reported in August 2025 that Guinea-Bissau's international connectivity is confined to the coast](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2908-131059-deploiement-de-la-fibre-optique-la-guinee-bissau-veut-apprendre-du-tchad>). [It said the country still needs a national backbone to link its main cities](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2908-131059-deploiement-de-la-fibre-optique-la-guinee-bissau-veut-apprendre-du-tchad>). Nothing dated later says one is being built or is in service. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No plan, study, tender or money promised counts. Preparing would need a national fibre backbone under contract, or works begun, in the past three years.

[Gabon's state infrastructure holder SPIN reports that on 10 November 2025 the Gabonese and Equatorial Guinean ministers inaugurated the interconnection of the two national fibre backbones](<https://spin.ga/alliance-historique-numerique-gabon-guinee-equatoriale/>). [Tests confirmed stable traffic exchange between Bitam and Ebebeyin and between Libreville and Bata](<https://spin.ga/alliance-historique-numerique-gabon-guinee-equatoriale/>). The document names no regions or length for the Equatorial Guinean network. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

The Ministry of ICT says [phase 2 connected the remaining 18 counties and 3 towns in 2017, giving all 47 counties a connection](<https://ict.go.ke/last-mile-county-connectivity-project-lmccp>). ODI wrote in 2025 that [phase 2 was still incomplete](<https://odi.org/en/publications/chinas-infrastructure-finance-in-africa-impacts-and-lessons/>). It names no county without fibre. In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the ICT Authority opened a tender for national backbone links](<https://www.itweb.africa/article/kenya-opens-fibre-backbone-tender/KjlyrvwBxmGqk6am>), and [in October 2026 the ICT principal secretary said a 17,000 km project to link all public institutions is under way](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/government-targets-grassroots-internet-connectivity-to-open-up-global-digital-market-for-youth/>). No source found says other operators buy capacity on the government backbone. Mature would need that, or open-access or wholesale terms.

[CSquared, USAID and Digital Invest committed to building a 350 km backbone crossing 13+ towns in Margibi, Bong and Nimba counties](<https://csquared.com/csquared-marks-significant-milestone-in-advancing-liberias-digital-connectivity-2/>). [It connects Monrovia to the Ivory Coast and Guinea borders](<https://csquared.com/csquared-marks-significant-milestone-in-advancing-liberias-digital-connectivity-2/>), and CSquared describes it as Liberia's first open-access fibre backbone. [LTA Chairman Massaquoi says the fibre line had already reached Loguatuo from Monrovia](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/news/liberia-on-the-verge-of-5g-revolution/article_992b027e-4c8a-4578-bf70-baf2e2eabeeb.html>), and gives no length or date. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[The Minister of Finance told Parliament that optical fibre deployment is being implemented, with a 96km stretch from Roma to Thaba-Tseka underway](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-02/Budget%20Speech%202025%2026%20Final%2019-02-2025.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says any of it is in service between the capital and another region. Establishing would need backbone fibre in service between the capital and one other region.

[Inwi says its network has a long-distance, high-speed backbone extending across the nation, with more than 9,000 km of own and leased fibre](<https://inwi.ma/en/wholesale/our-network>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[Orange Madagascar's Antananarivo-Toamasina fibre link was put in place in 2024](<https://2424.mg/telecommunications-mahajanga-desservie-par-un-reseau-fibre-optique-dorange-madagascar/>), with works launched in August 2024. In the last twelve months, [Orange Madagascar inaugurated on 1 December 2025 a 558 km fibre link from the capital Antananarivo to Mahajanga](<https://2424.mg/telecommunications-mahajanga-desservie-par-un-reseau-fibre-optique-dorange-madagascar/>), which it calls a national backbone. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[In January 2024 a $117.3 million contract was approved to extend fibre to Mopti, Koro and Timbuktu over 24 months](<https://cioafrica.co/landed-not-delivered/>), CIO Africa reports. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says backbone fibre is in service between Bamako and another region. Establishing would need backbone fibre in service between the capital and one other region.

[Tmcel's technical documentation, reported by Club of Mozambique, gives around 6,500 km of backbone fibre optic cable and about 4,500 km of access fibre](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-tmcel-ends-2025-with-1-79-mln-mobile-customers-prepares-for-strategic-partner/>). [The backbone links provincial capitals, major cities and hinterland countries](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-tmcel-ends-2025-with-1-79-mln-mobile-customers-prepares-for-strategic-partner/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

The World Bank says [five fibre links totalling 1,710 km were laid and in service by 2021](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099915008262277976/pdf/BOSIB0ef45e1210300bb6f0e08fc7c02a45.pdf>) under WARCIP APL2. In August 2025 a ministry representative said [over 4,000 km of the national fibre network had been completed](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/276833>). In the last twelve months, in December 2025 the director general of the state company SDIN [said it operates a national fibre network of more than 1,760 km](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/285647>). It runs on three main axes. No source found says it reaches every province. Operating would need such a source.

[ESCOM states its national fibre backbone covers all districts of Malawi including Likoma Island (coverage extended through investment in 2017 and 2021)](<https://africabbmaps.itu.int/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/ESCOM-Presentation-v.02-ITU-2025-Africa-BoradBand-Mapping.pdf>). [ESCOM's optic fibre business states its national fibre backbone network is 7000 km, built on its electricity poles](<https://africabbmaps.itu.int/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/ESCOM-Presentation-v.02-ITU-2025-Africa-BoradBand-Mapping.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says other operators buy capacity on the backbone, or that it runs on open-access or wholesale terms. Mature would need other operators to buy capacity on it, or it to run on open-access or wholesale terms.

[In its 2025/26 budget speech the ICT ministry put Namibia's fibre network at 18,719.5 km](<https://mict.gov.na/documents/869282/6089169/MICT_2025_2026_Budget_Speech+Full+Version.pdf/9b15c163-e790-96b8-f1af-ebd9573367b5?download=true&t=1746624578199>). In the last twelve months, [Telecom Namibia said in May 2026 that it was laying new long-distance routes](<https://www.telecom.na/media-centre/902-telecom-namibia-affirms-commitment-to-network-modernisation-amid-ongoing-service-improvements>) to give redundant paths between key cities and regions. [In March 2025 the competition commission said NamPower offers competitors access to its fibre through its Grid Online service](<https://www.namibian.com.na/nampower-telecom-mtc-given-30-days-to-revisit-unfair-agreement/>). No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[AidData says over 2,275 km of fibre was laid on three sections of Niger's national backbone](<https://china.aiddata.org/projects/58683/>): Niamey-Tillabéry, Zinder-Diffa and Agadez-Tahoua. Construction ended early in 2017. [On 14 November 2025 the communications minister provisionally received 1,031 km of fibre laid under the trans-Saharan backbone project](<https://www.latribune.fr/article/afrique/6030907088105514/le-niger-aborde-une-nouvelle-ere-de-connectivite-avec-la-dorsale-transsaharienne-a-fibre-optique>). In the last twelve months, [the project's coordinator said in March 2026 that provisional acceptance was still under way](<https://www.lesahel.org/session-ordinaire-du-comite-de-pilotage-copil-au-titre-de-lannee-2026-faire-le-point-des-progres-realises-et-prendre-des-orientations-pour-la-poursuite-des-activites/>). No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

The World Bank said in September 2025 that [Nigeria has no national backbone network, so operators duplicate one another's routes](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099091125121538069/txt/BOSIB-f3e6411b-ac7d-490f-a0ef-af1e4a6d1a28.txt>). In the last twelve months, the regulator's state data put [101,148 km of fibre across all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory](<https://nairametrics.com/2026/08/09/fg-incorporates-company-to-deliver-90000km-nationwide-fibre-network/>) in August 2026. That figure counts every operator's fibre. In August 2026 the minister said [contracting for the 90,000 km network was complete and laying would start within weeks](<https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/08/fg-to-rollout-90000km-fibre-optic-network-tijani/>). No source found says other operators buy capacity on the backbone, or that it runs on open-access or wholesale terms. Mature would need other operators to buy capacity on it, or it to run on open-access terms.

[In August 2025 btw.media reported that KT Rwanda Networks runs a fibre backbone of over 4,000 km](<https://btw.media/en/kt-rwanda-networks-rwandas-wholesale-4g-fibre-backbone>). It connects all districts and border areas. The company is a partnership between the government and Korea Telecom. [KT Rwanda Networks sells wholesale connectivity to other mobile and internet providers](<https://btw.media/en/kt-rwanda-networks-rwandas-wholesale-4g-fibre-backbone>). In the last twelve months, [Liquid said in September 2026 that its own national long-distance fibre serves Rwanda](<https://techtrendske.co.ke/2026/09/10/interview-liquid-bets-on-ai-as-next-growth-frontier-for-africas-fibre-network/>). [Ministerial Instructions 001/2012 state that the national fibre backbone had been completed](<https://rwandalii.org/akn/rw/act/min/2012/1/eng@2012-03-12>).

[Sudatel Group's FY2025 results say it added 1,586 km of new fiber backbone in 2025 and owns over 25,000 km of terrestrial fiber](<https://sudatel.sd/en/fy2025-results/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[Sénégal Numérique SA's director general states the state operator has 4,500 km of optical fibre across the national territory](<https://www.presidence.sn/wo/assets/documents/Communication-SENUM-CAMP-2025.pdf>). [It is present in 14 regions and 42 departments and connects over 400 administrative buildings by fibre](<https://www.presidence.sn/wo/assets/documents/Communication-SENUM-CAMP-2025.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[In January 2025 the minister said 1,641 km of new fibre took the backbone from 8 to 14 districts](<https://moice.gov.sl/minister-salima-outlines-accomplishments-in-the-tech-sector/>). In the last twelve months, Sierra Leone's backbone [reached 14 of its 16 districts by April 2026](<https://www.slena.gov.sl/post/sierra-leone-s-president-julius-maada-bio-commissions-natca-hq-reinforces-commitment-to-digital-inn>), Communications Minister Salima Bah said. [In April 2026 she said work was under way to reach Falaba and Karene](<https://libertyonlinetv.com/2026/04/30/15-million-world-bank-grant-secured-for-second-fibre-cable-landing-says-minister-of-communications-salima-bah/>), the two districts left. No source found says the backbone reaches every district, or that other operators buy capacity on it. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

In June 2022 the World Bank found that [South Sudan had no national fibre backbone](<https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/61714f214ed04bcd6e9623ad0e215897-0400012021/related/Digital-Economy-SouthSudan-jun22.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [in February 2026 Africa50 said fibre construction had begun](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/africa50_connectingafrica-digitalafrica-easttowestconnectivity-activity-7431791734906458112-_7PC>) on a route from Nadapal on the Kenyan border through Juba to Tambura. NCT South Sudan and Bayobab [launched the national backbone project that month](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/4204/nct-south-sudan-and-bayobab-collaborate-to-roll-out-national-backbone-fiber-network-project>), starting with the Juba to Nadapal segment. No source found says any of the backbone is in service between the capital and another region. Establishing would need backbone fibre in service between the capital and at least one other region, whoever owns it.

The regulator ESCCOM names [EPTC as the sole national backbone operator](<https://esccom.org.sz/publications/notices/docs/EPTC%20AND%20JENNY%20FINAL%20%20DECISION%20Notice%205.pdf>). In the last twelve months, its Notice 5/2026, in force from 1 July 2026, found [EPTC's existing national backbone an essential facility](<https://esccom.org.sz/publications/notices/docs/EPTC%20AND%20JENNY%20FINAL%20%20DECISION%20Notice%205.pdf>). It ordered EPTC to make the backbone [available to Jenny Internet on non-discriminatory terms](<https://esccom.org.sz/publications/notices/docs/EPTC%20AND%20JENNY%20FINAL%20%20DECISION%20Notice%205.pdf>). No source found says which towns or regions the backbone links, or that it reaches every region. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.

[Russell Southwood reported in November 2026 that Safitel's fibre connects 26 cities and towns](<https://russellsouthwood.substack.com/p/chad-living-in-a-landlocked-dangerous>), while routes in the south-east are unbuilt. The National ICT Broadband Backbone already [linked the headquarters of all 25 mainland regions by 2016](<https://www.mawasiliano.go.tz/pages/completed-project>), at 7,910 km. In the last twelve months, in December 2025 the minister said it [links every mainland regional headquarters and 122 of 139 districts](<https://www.tcra.go.tz/uploads/text-editor/files/MINISTERS%20STATEMENT%20WITSD%202026_1779118337.pdf>), at 15,167 km. In April 2026 operators [handed over about 1,193 km of new backbone routes](<https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/business/yas-tanzania-partners-hand-over-major-digital-infrastructure-to-government-5420804>) to the government. TTCL manages the backbone and sells capacity on it. In September 2026 it [raised that capacity to Burundi Backbone System from 4 to 10 Gbps](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/09/ttcl-bbs-increase-tanzania-burundi-connectivity-capacity-10gbps/>).

No source found says the backbone reaches every district. Operating would need a source that states the backbone reaches every province or region.
